### The Plot to Kill Jesus
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-april-8-2025.html
Passage: Matthew 26:1-2
Points:
- Jesus clearly informed His disciples that He would be handed over and crucified during the Passover.
- The Jewish authorities plotted against Him because His popularity and truth-telling challenged their power and their standing with Rome.
- The plotters hesitated to act openly during the festival out of fear of sparking a riot among the crowds.
- Even though human conspirators schemed against Him, these events fulfilled ancient biblical prophecies.
- God sovereignly directed every circumstance leading to the cross as part of His loving plan of salvation.

### An Unwitting Prophet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unwitting-prophet
Passage: John 11:49-50
Points:
- Even after witnessing the resurrection of Lazarus, hardened religious leaders refused to believe and reported Jesus to the authorities.
- The Sanhedrin gathered in fear that Jesus' popularity would provoke the Roman Empire into destroying their temple and stripping their power.
- Caiaphas proposed executing Jesus as a political calculation to safeguard the Jewish leadership and nation from Roman reprisal.
- Although speaking with malicious intent, Caiaphas unwittingly prophesied that Christ would die to purchase eternal salvation.
- God works sovereignly through the plots and intentions of fallen men to accomplish His good and saving will.
